intent_summary: An opt-in versioned forecast extension exposes native historical point and pattern evidence from the same frozen historical analysis.

criteria.criterion: One forecast call reuses its historical analysis and returns typed native signed reference, residual, score, triggers, maturity, calibration support, availability and detector provenance in original input positions.
criteria.notes: Inspected one reused analyze_dataset result, typed N-position projection, resolved thresholds and separate signed expectations/calibration metadata. The call-count regression and public installed artifacts passed.

criteria.criterion: Frozen-origin earlier point evidence and first-detection pattern snapshots survive changed or appended suffixes; provisional evidence cannot trigger, and retrospective screening is separate from anomaly qualification.
criteria.notes: Reviewed the native engine calibration rebuild/exclusion annotations and pattern merging. The projection excludes retrospective flags from point rows and truncates summaries through first detection. Prefix replay tests cover all supported rules plus target/suffix/appends under both policies.

criteria.criterion: Opt-in defaults preserve existing forecast arrays, signed decomposition, horizon prefixes and adjustment semantics; missing gaps and budget failures return unavailable without fabricated or partial evidence.
criteria.notes: Default opt-in preserves forward values and history. Missing gaps fail explicitly without filling. Tested budget failure at entry and during evidence projection, bridge caps, zeros and partial tails.

criteria.criterion: Public schemas, a single-call compatibility adapter and migration guidance document independent selectors, baseline labels, explicit materiality and version negotiation without changing Guard or saved notifications.
criteria.notes: Reviewed exact model schemas and single-call adapter; legacy response shape is retained without opt-in. Guide specifies two stacked independent selectors, defaults, version refusal, signed baseline labels, native qualification and retained caller materiality/severity policy. No UsageTap source changes were made.

verification_evidence: Primary agent self-review in this session; not an independent reviewer approval.
Clean Python 3.12 wheel and sdist installs outside checkout: 36 evidence regressions each, plus Guard/forecast/evidence smoke, dependency and entry-point checks.
Linux x86_64 Lambda Python 3.12: hash-required installation and public smoke/benchmark passed with networking disabled; four maximum-size evidence cases took 1.60s total.
docs/historical-anomalies-validation.md records artifact hashes, runtime image digest, commands and interpretation limits.
Stable 0.7.0 preflight after owner authorization: 417 source tests passed in 37.22s. Release documentation and version pins re-inspected; no detector implementation changes.
remaining_gaps: A separately approved stable release and separately reviewed UsageTap adoption are required before enabling the consumer detector.
